pairsWith.noteUz: 7-8-unitlar (Profiles, A Brush with Danger) bo'yicha nazorat testi: present perfect (yet/already/just/ever/for/since), past perfect, uy ishlari, salomatlik, xavf va qutqaruv so'zlari, ruxsat so'rash.

scanNote:
PROGRESS TEST 4 - Units 7-8 (75-bet, PDF 68). Yuqorida to'q sariq 'PROGRESS TEST 4' va 'Units 7-8'. Katakchalar: NAME, CLASS, DATE, MARK, (Time: 20 minutes).

'Vocabulary & Grammar':
1) 'Fill in the missing words.' 1 She hasn't gone back to work ...... . 2 Make sure you ...... medicines away from children. 3 Have you ...... your bed? 4 ...... I didn't call you yesterday. I was very busy. 5 I was ...... tired to do the ironing last night. 6 When she woke up, Tony had ...... left. 7 How ...... have you been working here? 8 Don't touch the iron. You'll ...... your finger. 9 All my friends came to my party except ...... James. 10 He has been in Rio ...... three weeks now. 11 "...... was the last time you went abroad?" "Two years ago." 12 She had cooked dinner ...... her guests arrived. 13 Have you ...... had mumps? 14 The night doctor comes ...... duty at ten o'clock. 15 They haven't smoked ...... last month. 16 He had ...... eaten Chinese food before he went to China. 17 They searched ...... the ring, but they couldn't find it anywhere. 18 He was so shocked, that he couldn't ...... a word. 19 The firefighter helped little John ...... safety. 20 She had ...... mopped the floor when the dog came in.
2) 'Choose the correct item.' 1 We didn't go out ...... it had stopped raining. A by the time B until C after. 2 There aren't many ...... in this museum. A exhibits B landmarks C tours. 3 I'm ...... I can't help you with the cleaning. A anxious B worried C afraid. 4 We saw a ...... of whales in the distance. A flock B herd C school. 5 He was so deep in ...... that he didn't hear the knock on the door. A thought B tide C beach. 6 What's ...... John? A problem B wrong C matter. 7 Jim hates going on ...... tours. A popular B guided C giant. 8 The boat started to ...... slowly. A sink B cover C gather. 9 Have you ever had a ...... bone? A broken B twisted C cut. 10 She ...... coffee when the phone rang. A is having B was having C had.

'Communication':
3) 'Complete the dialogues.' 1 A: ...... to the park with my friends? B: No, you can't. 2 A: I'm so sorry I didn't do the washing-up. I was very tired. B: Never ...... . That's OK. 3 A: What's ...... Jenny? B: I've got terrible earache. 4 A: Is ...... I play on my computer? B: Sure. 5 A: I've got terrible toothache. B: Why ...... the dentist?

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '75'.

exercises.explanationUz:
7-8-UNITLAR TAKRORI - 20 ta
  bo'shliq.

  PRESENT PERFECT so'zlari:
    hasn't gone back YET; Have you
    EVER had mumps?; has been in
    Rio FOR three weeks; haven't
    smoked SINCE last month; How
    LONG have you been working?
  PAST PERFECT so'zlari: had
    ALREADY left; had NEVER eaten;
    had JUST mopped; had cooked
    BEFORE guests arrived
  Uy ishlari: Have you MADE your
    bed?; TOO tired to do the
    ironing
  Salomatlik/xavf: KEEP medicines
    away; You'll BURN your finger;
    comes ON duty; helped John TO
    safety; couldn't SAY a word;
    searched FOR the ring
  Boshqa: SORRY I didn't call;
    except FOR James; WHEN was the
    last time?


⚠ 'MUMPS':

  = tepki (kasallik).


⚠ 'TO BE ON DUTY':

  = navbatchilikda bo'lmoq.

items.textEn: She hasn't gone back to work ___.
Make sure you ___ medicines away from children.
Have you ___ your bed?
___ I didn't call you yesterday. I was very busy.
I was ___ tired to do the ironing last night.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'too tired to do' = juda charchagan (qila olmadim).

items.textEn: When she woke up, Tony had ___ left.
How ___ have you been working here?
Don't touch the iron. You'll ___ your finger.
All my friends came to my party except ___ James.
He has been in Rio ___ three weeks now.
"___ was the last time you went abroad?" "Two years ago."
She had cooked dinner ___ her guests arrived.
Have you ___ had mumps?
The night doctor comes ___ duty at ten o'clock.
They haven't smoked ___ last month.
He had ___ eaten Chinese food before he went to China.

items.whyUz: ⚠ 'help ... to safety' = xavfsiz joyga olib chiqmoq.

exercises.explanationUz:
7-8-UNITLAR LUG'ATI VA
  GRAMMATIKASI.

  1 didn't go out UNTIL it had
    stopped = to'xtaguncha
  2 EXHIBITS in a museum =
    eksponatlar
  3 I'm AFRAID I can't = afsuski
  4 a SCHOOL of whales = kitlar
    to'dasi
  5 deep in THOUGHT = o'yga botgan
  6 What's WRONG, John? = nima
    bo'ldi?
  7 GUIDED tours = gid bilan sayohat
  8 The boat started to SINK =
    cho'ka boshladi
  9 a BROKEN bone = singan suyak
  10 She WAS HAVING coffee when ...
    (past continuous)


⚠ HAYVON TO'DALARI:

  a flock of birds/sheep; a herd of
  cows/elephants; a school of
  whales/fish.


⚠ 'TWISTED':

  = burilgan (ankle - to'piq).

items.textEn: We didn't go out ___ it had stopped raining.
There aren't many ___ in this museum.
I'm ___ I can't help you with the cleaning.
We saw a ___ of whales in the distance.
He was so deep in ___ that he didn't hear the knock on the door.
items.uz: U shunchalik o'yga botgan ediki, eshik taqillaganini eshitmadi.

items.textEn: What's ___ John?
Jim hates going on ___ tours.
items.uz: Jim gid bilan sayohatlarni yomon ko'radi.

items.textEn: The boat started to ___ slowly.
Have you ever had a ___ bone?
She ___ coffee when the phone rang.
items.uz: Telefon jiringlaganda u qahva ichayotgan edi.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Uzoq harakat + qisqa uzilish → past continuous.

exercises.explanationUz:
RUXSAT, UZR, SALOMATLIK
  DIALOGLARI.

  1 'No, you can't' → Can I go to
    the park?
  2 Uzrga javob → Never MIND. That's
    OK.
  3 'terrible earache' → What's THE
    MATTER / WRONG, Jenny?
  4 'Sure' → Is IT OK IF I play?
  5 'toothache' → Why DON'T YOU GO
    TO the dentist?


⚠ 'NEVER MIND':

  = hechqisi yo'q.


⚠ 'EARACHE' / 'TOOTHACHE':

  = quloq og'rig'i / tish og'rig'i.

items.textEn: A: ___ to the park with my friends?  B: No, you can't.
A: I'm so sorry I didn't do the washing-up. I was very tired.  B: Never ___. That's OK.
A: What's ___ Jenny?  B: I've got terrible earache.
A: Is ___ I play on my computer?  B: Sure.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'Is it OK if I ...?' = ... qilsam bo'ladimi?

items.textEn: A: I've got terrible toothache.  B: Why ___ the dentist?
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'Why don't you go to the dentist?' - maslahat.

patterns.formula: KIM + has/have (not) + V3 + yet / already / just / ever / for / since
patterns.exampleEn: She hasn't gone back to work yet. He has been in Rio for three weeks.
patterns.exampleUz: U hali ishga qaytmadi. U uch haftadan beri Rioda.

patterns.formula: KIM + had (already/just/never) + V3 + before/when + O'TGAN ZAMON
patterns.exampleEn: She had cooked dinner before her guests arrived. She had just mopped the floor when the dog came in.
patterns.exampleUz: Mehmonlar kelishidan oldin u ovqat pishirgan edi. It kirganda u endigina polni yuvgan edi.

patterns.formula: Can I ...? / Is it OK if I ...? → Sure. / No, you can't.
patterns.exampleEn: Is it OK if I play on my computer? - Sure.

patterns.formula: What's the matter / wrong? - I've got terrible earache. - Why don't you go to the doctor?
patterns.exampleEn: What's the matter, Jenny? - I've got terrible earache.
patterns.exampleUz: Nima bo'ldi, Jenni? - Qulog'im qattiq og'riyapti.
